source_limits: All configured companion bodies execute with original engine/Unit/Skill loading and startup; supplied buffs cannot alter zero-growth slot selection.
Native HP, buffs, summons, growth rebuilding and live enumeration remain explicit adapters; custom damage/ultimate behavior is not simulated gameplay.
Viewing this conditional exchange establishes neither occurrence, battle result nor task completion.
Original InitEffectNpc, effectNPC, Unit, Skill and both selected1903/201 bodies execute jointly, using the native camp enum and hero iterator. GrowthID=0; no additional growth override was assumed.
First update requests13110330 once on the field caster, independent of captured enemy presence.
Only initially alive nonsummoned enemy3016 is captured. Native Unit/Skill names fogbishop_ult and fogbishop_atk2 are checked separately against configuration.
First named ultimate Start forwards then requests13110331 once per target. Named atk2 Finish forwards then requests four summons each time; it requests no dialogue.

SetHp tests old HP strictly below30percent of attribs.HP before the underlying setter, grants1000MP and requests13110332 once per target. Crossing from above is insufficient until a later setter invocation.
Empty, unmatched, summoned, missing/wrong skill names, matching ally and later-added enemy are negative controls; new battle instances reset captured state.
HP/MP mutation, skill event delivery, summon allocation and final rendering are host boundaries. No victory, accepted result, task completion or retry-story join is inferred.
